title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour, part of their 2027 world tour, to Great Southern Bank Arena, where they take on the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals in a show with fan participation on the court and the jumbotron. It is for all ages, and admission is listed as free. It takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO, with doors at 6:00 PM and a free pre-game tip-off party starting when doors open.
